actions.name: Bullet Time
actions.description: As a reaction when it would take damage from a ranged attack, the mech can try to dodge the hit, attempting a Reflex saving throw with a DC equal to 15 + the enemy creature's CR or mech tier. On a success, the attack misses.

actions.name: Temporal Pulse
actions.description: As a standard action, the mech emanates a burst of chronological energy in an 80-foot radius. Allied creatures and mechs within the area can take an extra move action on their turn, while enemy creatures and mechs within the area must succeed at a Will save or lose their move action for the turn. This effect lasts for 1 round.

description.value:
A frame with a dull coppery sheen that produces strange temporal effects.

@PPAbility[cost:2]{Bullet Time} As a reaction, attempt to dodge a ranged attack (DC 15 + attacker's CR or tier).

@PPAbility[cost:4]{Temporal Pulse} Create an 80-foot radius effect that grants allies an extra move action or denies enemies theirs (Will save DC 12 + half mech tier).

A mech can have only one starmetal frame system.
